verdict.rationale: mise lets a project declare its tool versions in `mise.toml` (or asdf `.tool-versions` and idiomatic files like `.node-version`), switches to those versions automatically per directory, and shows which config file each active version came from. For reproducibility, the docs recommend pinning exact versions, committing a lockfile and running `mise install --locked`, and an independent user confirms mise pins exact versions across many languages. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of how the lockfile enforces pins or rejects drift, and an explicit exact-pin example inside a project `mise.toml`.
